messages:
alex: heads up — noticed a ~12h hole in agg.hourly for EU region (2026-03-15 02:00-14:00 UTC). counts drop to 0 for many tenants. looks like late kafka partition + upsert ordering. can we do a targeted recompute for the affected hour range instead of a full backfill?

maria: +1 on targeted. full backfill would hit quota and churn dashboards. any quick way to get the tenant list?

li: ran a quick query, this returns tenants with missing rows:
```
SELECT tenant_id FROM agg.hourly
WHERE region = 'eu' AND hour = '2026-03-15T02:00:00Z' AND value IS NULL
GROUP BY tenant_id LIMIT 200;
```
I got ~38 tenants. posting list in a sec.

alex: thanks li. plan idea: dry-run -> surface delta in console (row counts + token cost) -> canary recompute for 2 suspicious tenants -> scale if green. also want automatic skip/fallback if replayer hits malformed event.

devon: console API currently accepts tenant lists for reprocess, but it doesn’t accept a window-only param (it always needs a full-day). I can add a small patch to accept start/end windows for hourly recompute. low-risk.

jordan: we should also expose expected slot usage in the UI so ops know concurrency impact. otherwise sched will throttle and take forever.

ops: FYI ops can run manual job if needed. we have an 8-slot concurrency cap on EU by policy — don’t exceed it unless we pre-approve.

alex: ok — proposal:
1) devon patches console API (staging) to accept --window flag by EOD.
2) li shares tenant list (38).
3) run dry-run for entire tenant set with --dry-run to compute expected diff & estimated tokens.
4) surface dry-run results to console dashboard (new panel: recompute-delta).
5) canary run for 2 tenants with manual ops approval.
6) if delta < 1% and no errors, schedule batched runs with concurrency=4 and auto-skip on malformed events.

maria: add tagging: telemetry:recompute and add alert on absolute delta > 2% or negative delta (data loss). Also capture per-tenant before/after schema hash.

devon: timeline: I can land a minimal API change in staging by 1746520000, test with dry-run CLI and then promote. rollback is trivial (revert flag).

li: paste tenant snippet: tenant_014, tenant_109, tenant_022, tenant_087, tenant_300, ... (full list uploaded to drive: https://redwood-internal/drive/recompute/eu-20260315-tenants.csv)

jordan: for dry-run, add a small metric: recompute.expected_rows and recompute.actual_rows (tagged by tenant + window). we can graph delta% on the console.

ops: I'll provision a temporary slot-increase to 12 for the canary period if you promise to throttle after the first batch. please ping when ready and include run id.

alex: good — I'll coordinate. dry-run command I'd run (example):
```
reprocess-cli --window 2026-03-15T02:00:00Z/2026-03-15T03:00:00Z \
  --region eu --kind hourly --tenants-file s3://recompute/eu-20260315-tenants.csv \
  --dry-run --output metrics://recompute/dry-run/1746504321
```

sre-bot: [deploy] triggered: devon/console-window-flag -> staging (ci/2456). link: https://ci.internal/2456 :rocket:

maria: also add a pre-check to ensure source kafka partition lag is stable. we don't want concurrent late-arriving events during recompute window.

devon: noted — will include a flag to abort if kafka-lag > 2m at start time.

alex: final ops checklist before canary: tenant list uploaded, dry-run metrics posted, ops slot bump ready, canary tenant names + owner, rollback plan (stop job + mark tenants as skipped).

li: uploaded dry-run results to console panel: recompute-dryrun/1746504321 — expected rows 12,340 vs current 0 for many tenants. token est ~3.2M.

jordan: looks good. I'll create a temporary dashboard tile for delta and hook an alert: if delta% > 2 or errors > 0.1% during canary, auto-stop.

ops: standing by. ping @ops when you want the slot bump and I'll run the manual launch if console goes weird. :+1:

alex: launching dry-run in ~10m, will update here with metrics link. thanks all.
